verdicts.reason: A drops the confetti background, so the brand feel is gone. Its '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow has moved below the body copy and been enlarged until it competes with the headline. The Inkwell & Lantern logo is a tiny, illegible smudge stuck next to the legal text, and there is a lot of dead space between the book and the CTA. B keeps the confetti, card, book and a strong headline, so it is more faithful. But it squeezes the CTA, logo, eyebrow and legal text into one cramped bottom row where the CTA is buried and the logo can't be read, and both the book and the card are jammed against the top and bottom edges.
